logic.description: Oran Rief survivalist (ranger) — playable character. Combo M → B → P (Move, Block, Posture): Rule 16 — play exactly that action sequence in order and, while in contact with an enemy, deal +1 bonus damage; the engine seeds the three combo cards into the 11-card action deck. Adept in elem_vitality (stat Vitality, own value 16): Rule 16 'Adept' emits that element with power 20 regardless of the underlying stat, and the tower of that element admits the character without the 20-stat requirement. Stats V16/W10/M3/Wi11, Σ 40 (species_sum_rule: playable races have Σ = 40); life 4 = round(Σ/10); Vitality (elem_vitality) dominates (16), so its Rule 21 casts of those elements carry the biggest delta and it shrugs the same elements off. 3 actions per round (Rule 1); after the last turn of a round it discards and draws up to five (Rule 10).

prerequisites.description: A character with life 0 is down and plays nothing.
The adept element elem_vitality may be emitted only while no Disable bars it for this character.
Rule 16: the +1 combo damage applies only while in contact with an enemy.

effects.description: Life = round_half_up(Σstats / 10).
Σ stats (species_sum_rule: 40 for playable races).
The raw stat behind the adept element (stat_of); 0 when there is no adept element.
Rule 16: an adept emits its element with power 20 regardless of the stat; 0 when no adept element.
Number of actions in the trained combo.
Rule 16: +1 damage when the combo was just completed (combo_complete in context) and an enemy is in contact.
Actions per round (Rule 1).
Rule 10: cards drawn at the end of a round to get back to 5.
